name: watches
description: WatchShop.com: a Next.js 16 + Firebase watch store with a full admin dashboard. Shop men’s, women’s, luxury and smart watches from Rolex, Omega, Seiko, Tissot, Casio and more. Includes orders, products, customers and settings management, plus a demo mode that runs without any backend.

paragraphs: Premium watches for every moment. WatchShop is an online watch store built with Next.js and Firebase: a storefront for men's, women's, luxury and smart watches, plus a staff dashboard for products, orders, customers and store settings.
It runs out of the box in demo mode (sample catalogue, sample orders and a built-in admin login, all without Firebase) and switches to a live Firebase backend as soon as you add your project keys.
features: Homepage: hero with featured watch, shop by category, promo banners, best sellers, top brands, collection banner, featured collections, deals banner, latest arrivals, customer reviews, newsletter sign-up
Shop listings by category (Men's, Women's, Smart, Accessories, Deals), collection (Classic, Sport, Luxury) and brand, with sorting
Product pages with image gallery and zoom, colour and size options, rating, specifications, related products and Product structured data for SEO
Live search in the header, wishlist, slide-out cart and checkout (Cash on Delivery)
Customer accounts with order history, plus Brands, Contact and Help Centre pages

requirements.text: It runs out of the box in demo mode (sample catalogue, sample orders and a built-in admin login, all without Firebase) and switches to a live Firebase backend as soon as you add your project keys.
Sign in at /login with the DEMOADMINEMAIL and DEMOADMINPASSWORD values from .env.local (change them there whenever you like).
Hero text, delivery charges, contact details and social links: dashboard → Settings (no code needed).
